pkgmetadata.longdescription: RustyRoon is a clean-room Rust reimplementation of Roon Server supporting Roon 1.8 binary remoting, SOOD discovery, Moo WebSocket, RAAT audio streaming, Roon 2.75 / ARC TLS 55000 mobile endpoints, OpenAPI REST/MCP, embedded standalone Web UI, and an interactive TUI client.
